verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents its own recurring, schedule-driven capability: monitors that watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and emit signed change events. This is scheduled re-fetching of web content, but it is framed as change monitoring, not as general scheduled scrape or crawl jobs. The async batch crawl (docs-3) is a one-off background job, not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduling of arbitrary scrape/crawl/extract jobs, cron-style or specific-time scheduling controls, documentation of schedule granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.
